notes.title: IMPORTANT NEWS 2021-04 - NEW RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hi my friends,

After many works and thinking, I’ve decided I will release a [b]new concept of the game[/b]. You know I’m alone and I make it in part-time job, so I had to make a big decision. I saw you just wait and wait the update, but I haven’t had enough time to finish the new chapter(currently it’s 70%), because I have to work in my full time job (I have to eat:))). 
So I figured out a [u]new concept,[/u] [b]it focuses on sexual scenes[/b] and I can always give you update in 2-3 weeks. Soon I will release it [b]on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1482060/Lands_Of_Peace_Legends__Chapter_1/]Steam[/url] and on my [url=https://www.patreon.com/sinsmith]Patreon[/url][/b](more content), too.  

I hope you are glad and curious.

Bests,
Steve
